name: @voice-kit/wake
description: voice-kit: the wake word 'Hey Lampas' in the browser. A small detector (log-mel front end, a 1-D convolutional network and a rule), the microphone tap (an AudioWorklet) and the Web Worker that runs it, and the trained model packed beside them; startWake() opens the microphone and calls you for each wake. No React, no dependency, no bundler needed: the worklet and the worker start from blob: URLs.

scripts.build: node scripts/embed.mjs && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/embed.mjs --models
